measurement_notes.precision: float32 compute; FP16 casts included for every implementation
measurement_notes.timing: warmup excluded; synchronized block wall latency; per-call event includes host idle
measurement_notes.graph: captured single iteration; event interval per replay largely excludes Python dispatch
measurement_notes.stream: one dedicated nondefault stream shared by input creation, oracle, qualification, eager, graph capture/replay and profiling
measurement_notes.profile: profiling collected after latency measurements; profiler affects kernel durations
measurement_notes.correctness: independent FP64 grid_sample output and all3 gradients; feature-pixel location gradients
measurement_notes.int32_safety: every input numel/address product <= INT32_MAX/2; contiguous valid positive metadata
measurement_notes.no_fill_defaults: process-local bypass only for fully supplied canonical forward fixed schema; restored after each qualification/measurement/profile

safety_assumptions: Harness verifies valid spatial shapes and offsets before calling any variant.
Harness verifies positive dimensions and each tensor numel and all index products <= INT32_MAX / 2.
Half-range headroom covers out-of-image bilinear neighbor offsets and rounded grid increment.
Inputs, outputs and metadata remain identical; metadata storage stays torch.int64.
Native wrapper is unmodified, including allocations, device guard, host validation and dtype dispatch.
No fast-math flags are used; float32 and float64 compilation policy is preserved.
no_bounds can fail on 1024-thread launches if register allocation exceeds hardware resources.

variants.name: baseline
changes: Unmodified project CUDA sources; minimal pybind wrapper instead of package dispatcher.

variants.name: int32
changes: Narrow all header loop, work-count, decomposition, stride and bilinear offset arithmetic to int32; retain int64 metadata loads/check and native host wrapper.

variants.name: no_metadata
changes: Remove per-thread, per-level metadata assertions and return guards.

variants.name: int32_no_metadata
changes: Narrow all header loop, work-count, decomposition, stride and bilinear offset arithmetic to int32; retain int64 metadata loads/check and native host wrapper.
Remove per-thread, per-level metadata assertions and return guards.
